content.short: Gains Network provides gains Network's gTrade is a decentralized leveraged trading platform.
content.description: Gains Network is building a decentralized leveraged trading platform called gTrade, offering low trading fees, a wide range of leverages and trading pairs, and superior capital efficiency. The protocol is powered by the GNS and ERC721 utility tokens, designed to enable ownership of the protocol through revenue capture and governance. In the long term, the network aims to be a DAO governed by the GNS token, delivering cutting-edge DeFi products that generate revenue for GNS holders. A real-time Chainlink-based oracle provides the median price for each order, increasing transparency and fairness.
